name: japan-intel-mcp
display_name: Japan Intel MCP — 日本の公開情報
description: Read-only Japan public intelligence for AI agents: earthquakes, weather warnings, typhoons, and postal lookup. All sources are free and keyless (Japan Meteorological Agency, zipcloud). Every response carries its sources and data_gaps.
long_description: Japan Intel MCP exposes Japan's live public information to AI agents through six read-only tools: japan_earthquakes (seismic events with epicenter, magnitude, max intensity, depth), japan_weather_warnings (active weather advisories by prefecture), japan_weather_overview (Japan Meteorological Agency narrative forecasts for 10 major prefectures), japan_typhoons (currently monitored typhoons), japan_postal_lookup (postal code to address in kanji and kana), and japan_watch_summary (a single cross-source snapshot). No API key, no account, no paid subscription. Every tool returns an envelope containing retrieved_at, sources, and data_gaps, so agents never silently lose a data source.

tools.name: japan_earthquakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes in and around Japan from the Japan Meteorological Agency (epicenter, magnitude, max intensity, depth).

tools.name: japan_weather_warnings
tools.description: Active weather warnings and advisories by area, from the Japan Meteorological Agency.

tools.name: japan_weather_overview
tools.description: Narrative weather overview text for major Japanese prefectures.

tools.name: japan_typhoons
tools.description: Typhoons currently monitored by the Japan Meteorological Agency.

tools.name: japan_postal_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a Japanese postal code to prefecture, city, and town in kanji and kana.

tools.name: japan_watch_summary
tools.description: One-call cross-source snapshot of earthquakes, weather warnings, and typhoons.
